business_problem: Emerson needed to understand customers better in digital channels so it could reduce long, high-dropoff web forms for complex industrial products and deliver more relevant sales and marketing experiences across global systems.
solution_summary: Emerson implemented Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform as the hub for unifying digital and enterprise data from Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Sales, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, and additional systems. Unity assembles richer customer profiles from marketing interactions, CRM activity, and known account information, then feeds those insights back into Eloqua so marketing teams can personalize outreach and use progressive form strategies instead of asking buyers to complete long technical forms up front. Oracle Sales benefits from stronger intent signals as Unity connects repeat visits and digital interactions, helping teams recognize qualified opportunities earlier. By making customer data portable across marketing and CRM workflows, Emerson created a step-by-step digital buying journey for technical products that improves relevance, reduces friction, and gives the company a foundation to orchestrate content for its 1.2 million customers over time.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)

solution_components.name: Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform
solution_components.role: Unifies customer signals and profile data from marketing, CRM, and enterprise systems into a shared decisioning layer.

solution_components.name: Oracle Eloqua
solution_components.role: Uses the unified customer data to drive more relevant email and digital marketing engagement.

solution_components.name: Oracle Sales
solution_components.role: Consumes connected customer signals to help sales teams identify interest and qualified opportunities earlier.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
solution_components.role: Serves as one of the enterprise systems connected to the broader Oracle customer data ecosystem at Emerson.

data_flow: Marketing, CRM, and enterprise data is unified in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform, where customer profiles are enriched and connected across visits; those profiles are fed back into Oracle Eloqua for personalized email and progressive forms and into Oracle Sales so teams can spot buying signals and route prospects more effectively.
business_outcome: Emerson raised marketing email performance above industry averages, reduced online form length from 12 fields to 3, improved the quality of digital customer interactions, and created a data foundation to serve the right content to 1.2 million customers at better moments in the buying journey.
metrics: Email open rate rose above the industry average
Online form fields reduced from 12 to 3
architecture_clues: Unity CDP connects Oracle and non-Oracle systems with out-of-the-box models
Progressive form fills reuse known customer data across visits
Unified digital interaction data is fed from CDP back into marketing and sales systems
evidence_quotes: Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform helped Emerson better understand customer interests and preferences, leading to higher open rates for marketing emails.
The unified data has also allowed the company to reduce the number of fields in online forms from 12 to just 3.
The long-term vision is to use Unity CDP as the foundation to deliver the right content, at the right moment, to each of its 1.2 million customers.
